items.q: Not Ellie, another Hill. He was a very big arranger. He wrote for a lot of acts and things on Broadway at the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Not Ellie, another Hill. He was a very big arranger. He wrote for a lot of acts and things on Broadway at the time.
